background: KBC Group is a Belgian bancassurer, funded by retail deposits in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia and Bulgaria and lending to households and companies in those markets, with insurance and asset management alongside.
synthesis: Ratings are A- on average across all three main agencies, none of them lower, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 26 Jul 2024; these are holding-company grades that sit below the bank's. Consolidated capital is on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers, with CET1 of 14.3% below the peer median and leverage of 5.5% level with it. Liquidity is strong, with LCR of 158% above the peer median and NSFR of 133% in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days: a steady name with liquidity as its clearer strength.
